page.layout: Running head at the top centre; below it one column of small text on the right side of the page, with a few lines of text at the centre-right lower down; "FINIS" set centred, near the lower middle. The library stamp in the centre is not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan is very faint. Only the running head and the column on the right show printed text, and almost none of it can be read. The lines marked illegible are estimates of their length. The library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) and the show-through are left out. The "FINIS" reading is fairly clear, but it is set off from the text and could be a printed word or a stray mark.
